value.rationale: This natural dimension-varying positive spherical copula family exhibits local-to-global dependence separation: any fixed number of coordinates becomes asymptotically independent while the entire absolutely continuous law retains an explicit KL constant and an event-based TV gap. The phenomenon matters for interpreting low-order dependence diagnostics, and the exact constant has a model-specific proof and a clear limiting regime. The elementary finite entropy expression is an ingredient, not offered alone as a paper-sized claim.
